notes: MXB Race Day Live v0.5.17 is a lean updater-recovery release for users whose v0.5.16 Tracks update did not complete. It re-forces the Tracks route and top-navigation install even on a partially updated v0.5.16 copy, preserves the verified MXB-Shop track image/direct-link mappings, and ships as a small hot-update package instead of re-downloading the large Windows binary payload. The updater itself is also hardened for future releases with multiple GitHub binary download routes, longer timeouts, SHA-256 verification on every route and clearer combined download errors.
